title: Chunky Garden Vegetable Soup with Tomato and Herbs
summary: A hearty, colourful soup packed with chunky vegetables, potatoes and green beans in a herby tomato broth, brightened at the end with lemon and parsley. Wholesome, filling and easy to make in one pot.
equipment: large heavy-based pot with a lid (at least 4 litres)

ingredients.item: celery stalks, cut into 1 cm dice
medium potatoes, cut into 1.5 cm dice
fine sea salt or table salt
green beans, cut into 2 cm lengths

steps.title: Soften the base
steps.text: Heat the oil in the pot over medium heat, add the onion, carrots and celery with a pinch of the salt and cook for 8-10 minutes, stirring, until soft and starting to colour. The salt draws out moisture so the vegetables soften faster, and the light browning builds a sweet, savoury foundation.

steps.title: Toast herbs and purée
steps.text: Stir in the garlic, thyme and oregano for 1 minute until fragrant, then add the tomato purée and stir for 1 minute more until it darkens slightly. Cooking the purée briefly caramelises its natural sugars, deepening the tomato flavour and taking away its raw edge.

steps.title: Simmer the potatoes
steps.text: Add the potatoes, the tomatoes with their juice, the stock, the remaining salt and the pepper. Bring to the boil, then cover and simmer gently for 15 minutes until the potatoes are just tender when pierced with a knife. Giving the firmest vegetables a head start means everything finishes cooking at the same time.

steps.title: Add the greens
steps.text: Tip in the courgette and green beans and simmer uncovered for 8 minutes, then add the peas for 2 minutes until everything is tender and the soup is boiling hot. Adding the quicker-cooking vegetables later keeps their colour bright and stops them turning mushy.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Stir in the lemon juice and parsley, taste and add a little more pepper if needed, then ladle into bowls. A splash of acid at the end lifts all the vegetable flavours and makes the broth taste fresher.

tips: A common mistake is adding all the vegetables at once, which leaves some mushy and others hard; follow the order so each cooks just right.
Cut the vegetables to the sizes given so they cook evenly.
Check the stock label to make sure it suits your dietary needs, including halal.
Add the lemon juice off the boil and just before serving for the brightest flavour.
storage: Cool, refrigerate within 2 hours and use within 4 days, or freeze for up to 3 months. Reheat until boiling hot (74°C) throughout.
